Calculation based on current data: the selected Grand-Prix is treated as the upcoming round. \n\nModel prediction, not an official result.
Prediction of positions and lap times in the selected qualifying session.
The model treats the selected Grand-Prix as the upcoming round and utilizes the current championship standings.

For past rounds, the calculation replicates the conditions at the time of the event. For future rounds, it does not account for driver point changes that may occur beforehand. Model results may differ from actual qualifying outcomes.
Preparing the prediction may take a few minutes.\n\nModel prediction, not an official result.
Select an option and tap "Save". Your response is considered accepted once the save is confirmed.\nAccount login is required to participate.

You can modify or delete your response until the deadline specified in the prediction. If you make changes, make sure to save it again. Once the deadline passes, submitting, modifying, or deleting responses will be unavailable.
The card displays the maximum reward for the prediction. A correct answer awards the full reward. Incorrect answers do not deduct previously earned points.
Weekend point predictions account for the total points earned in both the main race and the sprint, if applicable.
A tie option is available in certain prediction formats. In such cases, 50% of the maximum reward is awarded.
Prediction results are finalized based on the official outcomes of the events. Awarded points become final once the prediction results are announced.

Your responses, points, and leaderboard rankings are available in "My Predictions". Accuracy is the ratio of correct answers to the total of correct and incorrect answers. Ties and unresolved responses are excluded from this calculation.
